name: Goddess Lakshmi
shortDescription: Goddess of grace, prosperity and auspiciousness, seated upon the lotus.
description: Lakshmi rises from the churning of the ocean seated upon a lotus — beauty untouched by the waters around it. She is grace, auspiciousness and abundance in every form: health, harmony, generosity and inner contentment. Offer gratitude here for all that sustains your life.

art.imageAlt: Purna kalasha upon a lotus with golden coins
